name: finanzneo
description: FinanzNeo — eigenstaendiges Repo, extrahiert aus Studio-Clon am 2026-07-31

scripts.smoke: cd channels/finanzneo && npx remotion still src/index.ts FinanzNeo /tmp/ci-smoke.png --frame=0
scripts.finance:gallery: cd channels/finanzneo && npx remotion studio src/layout-gallery-index.ts
scripts.finance:animation-gallery:still: cd channels/finanzneo && npx remotion still src/animation-system/gallery/gallery-index.ts FinanceAnimationGalleryOverview /tmp/finance-animation-gallery.png --frame=90
scripts.finance:animation-gallery:sequence-still: cd channels/finanzneo && npx remotion still src/animation-system/gallery/gallery-index.ts FinanceAnimationGallery /tmp/finance-animation-gallery-sequence.png --frame=90
scripts.finance:animation-test-reel:still: cd channels/finanzneo && npx remotion still src/animation-system/test-reel/test-reel-index.ts FinanceAnimationFallbackPreview /tmp/finance-animation-fallback-preview.png --frame=75
scripts.finance:animation-test-reel:render: cd channels/finanzneo && npx remotion render src/animation-system/test-reel/test-reel-index.ts FinanceAnimationTestReel /tmp/finance-animation-test-reel.mp4
scripts.finance:animation-validate: npm run finance:animation-structure && npm run finance:animation-isolation && npm run finance:animation-typecheck && npm run finance:animation-test && npm run finance:animation-gallery:still && npm run finance:animation-gallery:sequence-still && npm run finance:animation-test-reel:still
scripts.finance:system-test: npm test && npm run finance:scaffold-test && npm run finance:e2e && npm run finance:render-qa-test && npm run smoke
scripts.test: npm run validate:finanzneo-syntax && npm run validate:finance-template && npm run validate:finanzneo-system && npm run validate:finanzneo-consistency && npm run typecheck && vitest run
